source_hash_caveat: Hashes are from the earlier verified September 2026 aggregate snapshot; this run's source hashes were not independently extracted from its artifact.
interpretation: A broad main-CPV 48-or-72 baseline finds cross-segment primary codes that a main-72-only baseline misses. CPV 7226's apparent misses fall from seven to one; 7222 from ten to seven. CPV 7231 remains six of eight. These are hypothetical search-baseline misses, not tested failures of incumbent procurement services.
limitations: Only one publisher's September publication cohort, not a complete national census.
Family cohorts overlap; family misses cannot be summed into unique missed notices.
Main-code baselines are hypothetical and not observed search results from competitor products.
Publisher status is not a verified open deadline; CPV tags do not prove a qualified business opportunity.
Small samples, especially CPV7231 n=8; no verified supplier time savings, buyer payment intent, AgentMine customers or revenue.
No raw notice, buyer or supplier records are included.
